limitations: Solver proof candidates and numerical self-checks; no independent-verifier receipt or Lean build.
The retained-energy and local-matching statements apply only to simple real elements, not the full zero multiset.
Small D/N is a conditional hypothesis, not a newly proved arithmetic fact about actual zeta zeros.
Box-profile sinc matching cannot be silently substituted into an optimized test profile.
Block phases need not agree; total mean density one and source cyclic-wrap consistency are not established.
Small discarded simple count does not guarantee negligible discarded Hilbert-Schmidt operator energy.
The no-trimming family is abstract, with repeated simple vectors; it is not a genuine simple-zero multiset.
Exact equality excludes non-real elements, but the shallow genuine-pair example prevents a uniform off-real count conclusion from small positive defect.
The anchor intrusion bound counts affected simple anchors, not non-simple pairs or their mass.
